title.value: AN ACT = To enact R.S. 40:1615, relative to fire fighting foam; to provide for the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam containing fluorinated organic chemicals
title.provenance: AN ACT = To enact R.S. 40:1615, relative to fire fighting foam; to provide for the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam containing fluorinated organic chemicals

location.provenance: Prefiled pursuant to Article III, Section 2(A)(4)(b)(i) of the Constitution of Louisiana.

status.provenance: AN ACT = To enact R.S. 40:1615, relative to fire fighting foam; to provide for the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam containing fluorinated organic chemicals

date.provenance: On and after January 1, 2022, no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals unless discharged under either of the following conditions

pfas_definition.provenance: "PFAS chemicals" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom, including perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances, and designed to be fully functional in Class B fire fighting foam formulations.

type.provenance: Proposed law prohibits the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals except under one of the following conditions

date.provenance: On and after January 1, 2022, no person shall discharge or otherwise use Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals unless discharged under either of the following conditions

who.provenance: "Person" means an individual, association, joint venture, partnership, corporation, limited liability company, political subdivision, municipality, or public or private organization of any character, including any agency, department, board, bureau, office, commission, district, corporation, and quasi-public corporation of the federal, state, municipal, or local government.

action.provenance: Proposed law prohibits the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals except under one of the following conditions

products.provenance: "Class B fire fighting foam" means any foam designed to extinguish flammable liquid fires.

value: The discharge or use is during prior prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation.
The discharge or use is during training at a facility with containment, treatment, and disposal measures that prevent uncontrolled release of the Class B fire fighting foam into the environment.
exceptions.provenance: Proposed law prohibits the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals except under one of the following conditions: (1) The discharge or use is during prior prevention or in response to an emergency fire fighting operation. (2) The discharge or use is during training at a facility with containment, treatment, and disposal measures that prevent uncontrolled release of the Class B fire fighting foam into the environment.

intentionally_added.provenance: Proposed law prohibits the discharge of Class B fire fighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals
